status_definitions.unsupported: No integrated price provider reports coverage.
status_definitions.discoverable: A provider reports coverage; no observations are stored yet.
status_definitions.temporarily_unavailable: Discoverable, but the latest ingestion attempt failed and nothing is stored.
status_definitions.ingested: Observations are stored as an immutable, hashed snapshot.
status_definitions.validated: The stored snapshot passed the blocking quality checks.
status_definitions.research_eligible: Validated, with at least 10 series meeting the eligibility rules (48+ monthly prices, 80% coverage, no gap over 6 months, coordinates, actual prices).
status_definitions.forecast_evaluated: Research-eligible and at least one completed out-of-sample evaluation exists.

countries.name: Afghanistan
countries.licence: WFP market price data via HDX HAPI: HDX HAPI Terms of Use and the licence of each underlying HDX dataset (WFP price datasets are published on HDX under CC BY-IGO); attribute WFP and HDX.
known_restrictions: Prices are nominal, in the currency and unit reported by WFP; nothing is converted or deflated.
HDX HAPI does not provide the original publication date of a price; as-of timing is an assumption.
Market coordinates are WFP's; weather at a market is a geographic proxy, not the commodity's growing area.
